name: Anglerfish
description: The Winterworks anglerfish in the vanilla mob style: a big boxy dusky head, a wide underbite of simple white fangs, small flat dot eyes and a chunky stalk arching over the face to a glowing bulb. Drawn at the female's size (males at 1/7). Minecraft pixel units, density 1: exports 1:1 to a vanilla entity model.
author: lowpix example
